## Agla scene, ek faisla chahiye
Caldera ab title se pehle mar jata hai, to church wala hissa ek **cold open** ban gaya hai (jaise Bond film me title se pehle ka action hota hai). Mera mashwara hai ki title ke baad agla scene yeh ho:

**CRYPT (30 s):** Organist church ke neeche tehkhane me utarta hai. Patthar ki deewar pe 12 naam hain. Wo **CALDERA** ka naam kaat-ta hai aur chaandi ka cross deewar ki keel pe latka deta hai. Camera deewar pe agle naam **ELDER GRIST** pe rukta hai. Phir wo bahar nikal kar ghode pe baithta hai aur ride out karta hai.

Is se series ka engine (12 naam) pehli hi baar saaf ho jata hai, aur baaki episode GRIST ke peechhe salt flats → canyon → ghost town → bridge tak jata hai. Isme ek nayi image chahiye hogi: crypt ki deewar, 12 naamon ke saath.

Yahi rakhein, ya title ke baad kuch aur chahte ho?

# IRON SUNDAY — Music Cue Sheet (ElevenLabs Music v2.5)
Style locked by the owner 2026-09-24: one dense descriptive paragraph per cue, Rango / reference-
channel spaghetti-western-mariachi sound, NORMAL pace (nothing frantic), and every cue built so it
can be faded out at any point in the edit: steady even sections, no sudden stops, no big final hit,
ending on a long sustained chord that fades on its own. Set the length manually; make two versions.
Never inside a video prompt — every clip's audio says "No music".

## 1. MAIN THEME — opening ride and credits (60 s)
```
Spaghetti western film score, dusty analog 1960s mix with wide stereo and punchy low end; 108 BPM steady galloping pulse, relaxed not rushed; instrumental; nylon-string guitar drives the verses, baritone electric twang and a mariachi trumpet duo trade the melody in the bigger sections, jaw harp, castanets, lonesome whistle motif, guitarron bass, a half-time break with choir-like oohs; mariachi and Tex-Mex swagger in the spirit of Rango; even, repeating sections with no sudden stops and no big final hit, so it can be faded out anywhere; ends on a long ringing sustained chord that fades out naturally.
```

## 2. THE ORGANIST — mask, organ, the walk-away (40 s)
```
Spaghetti western character motif, dusty analog 1960s mix with wide stereo and deep low end; 70 BPM slow steady pulse; instrumental; a lonesome whistled melody over tremolo baritone electric guitar in spring reverb, a soft distant male choir humming one wordless chord, a single tubular bell, sparse nylon-string guitar plucks, faint wind; ominous, patient, lonely, Morricone meets Rango; no percussion hits, no sudden changes, one mood throughout so it can be faded anywhere; ends on a sustained unresolved chord that fades out on its own.
```

## 3. CALDERA — the boss walks in (30 s)
```
Spaghetti western villain swagger, dusty analog 1960s mix with wide stereo and warm low end; 96 BPM lazy strutting shuffle; instrumental; slightly out-of-tune honky-tonk piano, wheezing accordion, walking guitarron bass, muted trumpet sliding into its notes, brushed snare, woodblock, castanet flourishes; greasy, confident, a little comic, mariachi and Tex-Mex flavour like Rango; loops evenly with no stops or stings, easy to fade anywhere; ends on a lazy sustained sour chord that fades out.
```

## 4. THE STAND-OFF — the organ stops, before the first shot (40 s)
```
Spaghetti western stand-off tension, dusty analog 1960s mix with wide stereo and a deep sub-bass drone; 80 BPM slow heartbeat pulse; instrumental; ticking pocket-watch percussion, low tremolo strings slowly swelling, a solo mariachi trumpet lament, baritone guitar holding one long twanging note, soft timpani heartbeat, a distant whistle; dread building gently, never exploding; no hits, no stops, the tension simply rises and holds so it can be faded or cut anywhere; ends on a long held tremolo chord that fades out.
```

## 5. THE GUNFIGHT — shotguns in the church (45 s)
```
Spaghetti western action cue, dusty analog 1960s mix with wide stereo and punchy low end; 118 BPM driving but controlled gallop, not frantic; instrumental; strummed nylon-string guitar, baritone electric twang lead, mariachi trumpet duo stabbing the off-beats, guitarron bass, galloping snare and tom rolls, castanets, whip cracks on every fourth bar, a half-time break with choir-like oohs; heroic, dangerous, Tex-Mex swagger like Rango; steady repeating sections with no sudden stops and no final crash, so it fades cleanly anywhere; ends on a sustained brass-and-guitar chord that fades out.
```

```
Spaghetti western theme reprise, dusty analog 1960s mix with wide stereo and warm low end; 84 BPM slow steady walking pulse; instrumental; the main-theme melody played slow on solo whistle and nylon-string guitar, baritone twang answering, a soft mariachi trumpet joining halfway, gentle castanets, low choir-like oohs underneath; proud, weary, quietly triumphant, Rango and Morricone; even and calm with no hits or stops so the title can land anywhere and the fade is clean; ends on a long ringing sustained chord that fades out naturally.
```

```
Spaghetti western closing cue, dusty analog 1960s mix with wide stereo and soft deep low end; 64 BPM slow steady pulse; instrumental; slow fingerpicked nylon-string guitar, a bowed musical saw answering it, one muted mariachi trumpet phrase, a single tubular bell, faint underground drips and wind; cold, patient, unfinished; one mood throughout with no stops so it fades anywhere; ends on an unresolved sustained chord that fades out on its own.
```

Title aur radio ke baad film me ab tak **~2.5 minute** ho chuke hain (ride 60 s + church 60 s + radio 30 s). 6-8 minute tak pahunchne ke liye **4-5 minute** aur chahiye. Isliye pehle baaki episode ka dhaancha, phir agla scene.

## Baaki EP01 ka raasta (meri sifarish)
**Salt flats ambush → Radio tower town → Episode ka aakhri boss**
Awaaz ne "...You" keh kar line kaati thi, matlab ab woh Organist ke peeche log bhejega. Is se action apne aap aata hai, aur har location ek hi baar aati hai.

## Agle scene ke 3 options

**A. SALT FLATS AMBUSH** ★ meri pasand · 2 clips · 60 s
Safed namak ka khula maidan, chhupne ki koi jagah nahi. Ufaq se **teen riders aur ek hover-truck** aate hain. Truck ki chhat pe ek ghoomne wali heavy gun lagi hai. Organist ghoda nahi rokta, seedha unki taraf daudta hai. Poori raftaar pe gunfight hoti hai, har rider ka apna shot, aur truck pe lagi gun namak me lakeerein kaat-ti hai. Organist ghode se truck pe koodta hai, gunner ko girata hai, aur truck namak pe palat jata hai. Aakhir me palti hui truck ke radio se wahi awaaz: *"...Keep coming."*
- **Kyun:** film ka sabse bright aur tez scene hai. Location ek baar aati hai, aur church ke andhere ke baad khuli safed roshni achha contrast deti hai.
- **Nayi images:** 3 riders ki alag sheets aur truck ki gun wali version. Truck image 3 me gun add karne wala prompt de dunga.

**B. RADIO TOWER TOWN** · 2 clips · 60 s
Kabaad se bana ek chhota sa town, jiske beech ek bohot uncha zang-khaya radio mast khada hai. Organist ghode pe andar aata hai aur saara town khamosh ho jata hai. Mast ke neeche ek darpok operator (chhota lizard, bade headphones) baitha hai. Organist bina bole shotgun mast ke tar pe rakh deta hai, aur operator kaanpte haath se ek purana naqsha nikal kar batata hai ki signal kahan jata hai.
- **Kyun:** tension aur thoda comedy, fight kam, aur agle boss ka pata milta hai.
- **Nayi images:** operator ki sheet aur town ki location.

**C. WATER CONVOY** · 2 clips · 60 s
Awaaz ka paani le jane wala convoy (do trucks aur riders) ek sookhe darya se guzar raha hai. Organist upar chattan se kood kar chalti truck pe aata hai, fight karta hai, aur paani ke barrel phat jate hain. Film me pehli baar **neela paani** dikhta hai (colour rule ke hisaab se paani hi akela neela rang hai). Driver maut ke darr se batata hai ki convoy kahan ja raha tha.
- **Kyun:** bohot visual scene hai aur paani se yeh bhi saaf hota hai ki is duniya me paisa kya hai.
- **Nayi images:** driver aur convoy ke riders ki sheets.

**Mera plan:** A ke baad B, aur B ke baad episode ka final boss. Isse action, phir tension, phir climax ka flow banta hai. C ko EP02 ke liye bacha kar rakhte hain.

---

## A. SALT FLATS AMBUSH (2 clips · 60 s · Organist + 3 riders)

**Transition in:** RD-01 ka aakhri shot chhote hote Organist pe ruka hai → **hard cut** → SA-01 ka pehla frame: **aerial wide**, safed namak ka maidan, Organist ek kaala nuqta jo left se right ja raha hai, peeche dhool ki patli lakeer. Rang ka jhatka (peela desert → safed namak) khud batata hai ki jagah badal gayi aur waqt guzra, "kuch der baad" likhna nahi padta.

**SA-01 (30 s)**
1. Aerial wide: Organist namak pe left→right, akela.
2. Uske ghode ke saath tracking medium. Wo achanak lagaam kheench kar rukta hai aur ufaq ki taraf dekhta hai.
3. Uski nazar (POV, long lens): right ki taraf ufaq pe **teen riders aur ek hover-truck** heat shimmer me se nikal rahe hain. Truck ki chhat pe heavy gun hai.
4. Riders ka medium: SKULL (truck pe gunner), aur do riders VEX aur BONES, poori raftaar se screen-LEFT ki taraf (uski taraf).
5. Organist ka close: dono shotgun kheenchta hai, ghode ko ed lagata hai, aur **unki taraf** right me daud padta hai. Hard cut.

**SA-02 (30 s)**
1. Truck ki gun fire karti hai aur namak me goliyon ki lakeer Organist ke ghode ke peeche peeche daudti hai.
2. Organist full gallop pe, left gun → VEX girta hai.
3. Right gun → BONES ghode se girta hai.
4. Organist ghode se kood kar chalti truck pe aata hai. SKULL ke saath hatha-pai, SKULL truck se neeche. Truck palat kar namak pe phisalti hai.
5. Palti truck ke paas: cab ka radio kharkharata hai, wahi awaaz: *"...Keep coming."* Organist radio pe ek fire karta hai, aur radio chup.

**Transition out:** SA-02 ka aakhri frame: dhuan aur namak ki dhool, Organist wapas ghode pe chadhta hai aur right ki taraf nikal jata hai → hard cut → agla scene usi direction me shuru hoga. Saath me ek sawal chhoot jata hai: awaaz tak kaise pahunche? Isi sawal ka jawab B hai.

---

## B. RADIO TOWER TOWN (2 clips · 60 s · Organist + operator)

**Transition in (A ke baad ho to):** SA-02 me radio phoda tha. Ab usi radio ki kahani aage badhti hai → hard cut → **low wide**: ufaq pe ek bohot uncha zang-khaya radio mast, uski chotti pe ek laal battee jalti-bujhti. Organist frame ke left se aata hai aur mast ki taraf right me ride karta hai. Audience turant jod leti hai: *"awaaz yahan se aati hai."*
**(Agar A skip karein):** RD-01 ke aakhri shot se seedha is shot pe cut. Tab mast ki battee usi rhythm me jalti-bujhti hai jis me radio ki dial jal rahi thi, aur yahi rhythm dono shots ko jodta hai.

**RT-01 (30 s)**
1. Town ki gali ka wide: kabaad ke ghar, khali. Organist dheere ghoda chalata hua andar aata hai (left→right).
2. Ek khirki ka shutter dhadam se band hota hai, phir doosra. Koi insaan dikhta nahi, sirf shutters.
3. Mast ke neeche ek tin ka kamra, aur uske andar ka close: **OPERATOR**, chhota bhoora lizard, bade headphones, kaanpte haath dials pe. Radio se wahi awaaz aa rahi hai.
4. Darwaza khulta hai aur roshni andar aati hai. Operator palat kar dekhta hai. Uski nazar (POV): darwaze me Organist ki kaali shakal.
5. Operator ka close: headphones utaar kar dheere se haath upar kar leta hai.

**RT-02 (30 s)**
1. Two-shot: Organist shotgun ki nali radio set pe rakh deta hai. Bolta kuch nahi.
2. Operator hakla kar: *"I-I just pass the signal on... it comes from the dam."* (sirf ek line)
3. Insert: kaanpte haath ek zang-khaya naqsha kholte hain. Ek bade **bandh (dam)** ke nishaan pe ungli rakhi jati hai.
4. Organist naqsha le kar mudta hai aur nikal jata hai. Operator ki saans chhoot-ti hai.
5. Bahar ka wide: Organist ghode pe right ki taraf nikalta hai, aur peeche mast ki laal battee jalti-bujhti rehti hai.

**Transition out:** naqshe pe **dam** dikha tha → hard cut → agle scene ka pehla frame: ek bohot bada sookha, zang-khaya dam, ufaq pe khada. Naqsha jahan ungli rakhta hai, agla shot wahi jagah dikhata hai. Isko **match cut** kehte hain: ek shot me cheez ka zikr, agle me wahi cheez saamne.

---

## C. WATER CONVOY (2 clips · 60 s · Organist + driver + 2 riders)

**Transition in:** RD-01 ke aakhri shot me Organist chhota ho raha hai → hard cut → **chattan ki chotti pe close**: Organist ke boot, neeche dekhte hue. Cut → uski nazar: neeche sookhe darya me do hover-trucks, paani ke barrel, aur saath me do riders, sab **left se right** ja rahe hain. Isse lagta hai wo convoy ke aage pahunch kar intezaar kar raha tha.

**WC-01 (30 s)**
1. Chattan pe Organist ka medium. Convoy ki awaaz qareeb aa rahi hai.
2. Convoy ka wide (neeche se): trucks dhool urate hue.
3. Organist chattan se **kood kar** pehli truck ki chhat pe girta hai.
4. Rider 1 ghoda paas laa kar fire karta hai. Organist ka left gun, aur rider ghode se neeche.
5. Rider 2 truck pe chadhne ki koshish karta hai, aur Organist ki laat se neeche girta hai.

**WC-02 (30 s)**
1. Organist cab tak jata hai. **DRIVER** (moti kachhua, goggles) steering chhod kar haath upar kar deta hai.
2. Organist barrel pe fire karta hai. **Neela paani** phat kar dhoop me uchhalta hai. Poori film me pehli baar neela rang dikhta hai.
3. Truck ruk jati hai aur paani ret me behta hai.
4. Driver ek line bolta hai: *"The water goes to the dam. To him."*
5. Organist ghode pe right ki taraf nikal jata hai. Peeche sookhi ret paani pee rahi hai.

**Transition out:** yahan bhi **dam** → agla scene dam pe.

---

## Pura flow
- **A → B → Dam (final boss):** yeh sabse strong hai. Pehle action, phir tension, phir climax.
- **C → Dam:** agar ek scene kam karna ho, to C akela A aur B dono ka kaam kar deta hai. Isme action bhi hai aur dam ka pata bhi mil jata hai.

Teeno raaste **Dam** pe khatam hote hain, jo EP01 ka final location hai. Wahan final boss (awaaz wala nahi, uska agla aadmi) aur uske 2 aadmi honge, yaani 4 characters ki limit ke andar.

Kaunsa raasta chunoge: **A→B**, sirf **A**, sirf **B**, ya **C**?

# TEST PROJECT — Screenshot -> Nano Banana blocking reference
Owner's idea, 2026-09-24. Kept separate from IRON SUNDAY until it is proven. Nothing here is a rule
for the film yet.

## The question
Can a location + character-position reference image, built by Nano Banana Pro from screenshots of
clip 1, make Seedance keep the room and everyone's positions in clip 2?

## Method
1. **Clip 1 (TEST-01, 30 s)** enters a NEW location and deliberately shows it in several WIDE shots
   from different angles, so the room and every character's place are revealed. After the characters
   take their places, nobody moves again until the clip ends.
2. The owner takes screenshots from clip 1 (at least: the doorway wide, the reverse wide, the high
   wide) and pastes them in chat.
3. The director compares the screenshots with the video prompt and writes the Nano Banana prompt:
   - the room is rebuilt as one clear image from an angle that shows both sides of the room;
   - each character is placed by name, with his reference sheet attached;
   - **conflict rule:** if a character is in two places across screenshots, the position he holds at
     the END of clip 1 wins; the earlier position is not drawn;
   - **extra character rule:** anyone visible in a screenshot who should not be in the blocking (a
     passer-by, a duplicate, someone who has left) is named in the prompt and explicitly excluded;
   - where the screenshots contradict the plan for clip 2, the director corrects it in the image
     prompt and says so.
4. The owner generates the image (image B1).
5. **Clip 2 (TEST-02, 30 s)** tags B1 as the location-and-blocking reference and continues the scene.
6. Judge: did the room match? did everyone stay in their places? did anyone duplicate or vanish?

## Pass / fail
- PASS: room layout, character places and screen direction hold across the cut between TEST-01 and
  TEST-02. Then the method goes into the skill and wide shots become allowed in every 30 s clip.
- FAIL: record exactly what broke (room, positions, extra characters, first frame) before any retry.

## Cost control
TEST-01 reuses sheets that already exist (image 5 CALDERA, 6 ORGANIST, 8 FANG, 10 TUSK, 1 heights),
so the test needs NO new character images. Only the Nano Banana blocking image is new.
Four characters, the owner's maximum.

# Nano Banana Pro — blocking reference template (filled in chat after the owner's screenshots)

```
LOCATION AND BLOCKING REFERENCE IMAGE for a photoreal CG creature-feature western. Build ONE clear
16:9 image of the room shown in the attached screenshots, seen from <CHOSEN ANGLE: high three-quarter
view from the back-right corner, so the entrance, both side walls and the centre are all visible>.

along the left wall, round card table in the centre, window in the right wall, staircase back-right>,

The CHARACTERS, each copied from his attached sheet and placed exactly here:
- <NAME> (<sheet>): <place>, <facing>, <pose>.
- ...
Exactly <N> characters. <EXCLUSIONS: "The figure standing at <place> in the first screenshot is NOT
included; <NAME> is drawn only at <end position>.">
Clean sharp frame, everything in focus, no motion blur, no text, no labels, no arrows, no extra
people.
```

Rules the director applies when filling it:
- Position conflicts between screenshots: the END-of-clip position wins; the earlier one is omitted.
- Anyone who should not be in the blocking is named and excluded explicitly.

## Screenshots kahan se lene hain
1. **Shot 1 ka aakhri hissa:** darwaze se wide, jab teeno upar dekh rahe hon.
2. **Shot 3:** ulta wide, Caldera ki kursi ke peeche se.
3. **Shot 4:** seedhiyon ke landing se upar wala wide. **Yeh sabse kaam ka screenshot hoga.**

Chauthe ki zaroorat nahi, lekin koi aur frame achha lage to woh bhi bhej dena.

## Tumhare bataye hue rules, jo main image prompt likhte waqt lagaunga
- Agar koi kirdar do screenshots me alag jagah pe ho, to **clip ke end wali jagah** chununga aur pehli jagah image me nahi aayegi.
- Screenshot me koi extra ya duplicate kirdar dikhe, to use naam se likh kar **exclude** karunga.
- Agar screenshot TEST-02 ke plan se takraye, to main image prompt me theek karke tumhe bata dunga.
- Image me koi arrow ya label nahi hoga. Woh pehle fail ho chuka hai, isliye kirdar seedha apni jagah pe khade dikhenge.

Render karo aur screenshots chat me bhejo. Uske baad Nano Banana ka prompt aur TEST-02 likhunga. Skill me yeh abhi **sirf test** ke taur pe likha hai (rule 39). Pass hua tabhi film me lagega.

## Dono ko kaise parkhein
Dono renders me yeh cheezein check karna:
1. **Kamra:** bar left pe, seedhiyan aage left, do khirkiyan right pe, peechli deewar me darwaza. Mirror to nahi ho gaya?
2. **Jagah:** FANG bar pe, TUSK khirkiyon ke beech, Caldera table pe. Kya sab wahin shuru hue?
3. **Shot 7, aakhri high wide:** kya FANG bar ke peeche aur TUSK khirkiyon ke neeche pade hain, aur table ulti padi hai? Yahi geometry ka asli test hai.
4. **Pehla frame:** kahin koi screenshot ya Nano image pehla frame to nahi ban gayi? Method B me yeh khatra zyada hai, kyunki S1 ka view SHOT 1 se milta-julta hai.

Dono me se jo **zyada jagahon pe sahi** nikle, wahi method film me lagayenge. Sab kuch test folder me log ho gaya hai ([README](README.md) ke "Run log" me), aur files hain [NANO-B1.txt](NANO-B1.txt), [TEST-02A.txt](TEST-02A.txt), [TEST-02B.txt](TEST-02B.txt).

## Caldera ne naya darwaza kyun banaya

**Wajah (meri prompt ki ghalti):** shot 6 me maine likha tha *"Medium of CALDERA alone… runs to the plank door in the back wall"*. Do cheezein galat theen:
1. **Asli darwaza shot shuru hote waqt frame me tha hi nahi.** Medium shot sirf Caldera pe tha, aur asli darwaza table se hat kar, bar wali taraf thoda left me hai.
2. **"Back wall" ka matlab model ne woh deewar samjha jo Caldera ke theek peeche thi.** Wahan koi darwaza nahi tha, to model ne wahin ek naya bana diya, kyunki prompt ne kaha tha "wall me door hai".

**Fix, ab har exit shot me:**
- Shot aisa frame hoga ki **asli darwaza pehle frame se dikhe**.
- Darwaze ki jagah fixed cheezon se bataunga: *"the one plank door in the back wall, left of the table, behind the end of the bar, as in @image 15"*.
- Raasta bhi likhunga: *"he runs left across the room to it"*.
- Avoid me: *"no new door, no opening in any wall other than the existing door"*.

## Fight ka naya rule
Jab dushman khule me khade hon aur chhupne ki jagah na ho, to **sab ek saath gun ki taraf haath le jayenge, aur hero unse tez hoga**. Left-right-left, takreeban 2 second me sab gir jayenge. Koi dushman apni baari ka intezaar nahi karega. Agar kisi ko waqt mil gaya, to woh kuch karega: fire karke miss karega, koodega, ya bhaagega. Shooter aur victim ke shots 1-1 second ke honge.

Teeno cheezein skill me **rule 40** ke taur pe save hain:
- **40.1:** screenshot wala method ab standard hai, wides har 30 s clip me allowed hain, aur Nano Banana positions ke liye use nahi hoga.
- **40.2:** exit ke waqt pehle se bana darwaza hi use hoga, aur woh frame me dikhega.
- **40.3:** khule me fight ek hi tez burst me khatam hogi.

## Ab awaaz asli kyun lagti hai
- **Pehli line:** pehle se bore hai, jaise roz ka kaam ho, aur Spanish ka ek lafz ("Contesta, hombre").
- **Doosri line:** apne aadmiyon pe shak karta hai ki kahin mera paani to nahi pee rahe. Paani is duniya me paisa hai, to line duniya se bhi judti hai.
- **Teesri line:** **saans ki awaaz se** samajh jata hai ki yeh uska aadmi nahi hai. Koi lambi baat nahi, bas *"Well, well."*
- **Chauthi line:** dhamki **dosti ke lehje me** deta hai, aur agle scene ki jaankari (tower aur Mott) usi baat ke beech me nikal aati hai, elaan ki tarah nahi.

Skill me **rule 49** save hai: dialogue insaani lagna chahiye. Tukde, naam, roz ki chidchidahat, apna lehja, aur kahani ki baat beech me se nikle. "Gunman", "friend" jaise bharti ke lafz nahi, aur hero ki tareef nahi. Test yeh hai: kya koi actor khud se aisa bol sakta hai?

**Agla scene:** radio tower pe **OLD MOTT**. Uski sheet ka prompt aur tower town ki entry wala clip likhun?

# Agla scene: RADIO TOWER (2 clips, 60 s)

**Pichhle scene ka logic yahan kaam aata hai:** awaaz ne radio pe tower ko hukm diya tha *"Watch the road!"*. Isliye tower wale **pehle se chaukanne** hain, aur Organist ke pahunchte hi tension shuru ho jati hai.

**Characters (4):** Organist + **tower operator** + **2 guards**. Teeno nayi sheets banani hongi.
- **OPERATOR:** ek boorha, darpok **moth-aadmi** (patangay jaisa). Uske lambe, pankh jaise antennae headphones ke beech se nikle hote hain, aur haath kaanpte rehte hain. Yeh Rango jaisa bilkul nahi hai.
- **2 GUARDS:** ek kaanton wali peeth ka **beetle** aur ek lamba **mantis-gunman**, dono ke paas rifle.

## RT-01 (30 s)
| Time | Kya hota hai |
|---|---|
| **0-6 s** | **Wide (reference ke liye):** mast ke neeche tin ke chand jhompde, bohot uncha zang-khaya radio mast, chotti pe laal battee. Organist gallop karta hua **left→right** aata hai aur kinare pe ghoda dheema karke rok leta hai |
| **6-11 s** | Mast ke upar ka cabin. Operator binocular se dekhta hai, ghabrata hai, aur mic pakad kar kehta hai: *"Boss… he's here."* |
| **11-16 s** | Seedhi ke neeche dono guards usse dekh kar **ek saath** rifle uthate hain |
| **16-20 s** | **Tez burst:** Organist dono ke fire karne se pehle dono ko gira deta hai. Har shot ek second ka |
| **20-25 s** | Upar operator mic chhod kar kaanpte hue cabin ke kone me chhup jata hai |
| **25-30 s** | **Reference wide:** mast, neeche dono guards ki laashen, khada ghoda, aur Organist seedhi pe chadhna shuru karta hai. Isi ke screenshots lene hain |

## RT-02 (30 s), mukhtasar
Upar cabin me: Organist andar aata hai, operator kone me dubka hua. Organist bina bole shotgun radio set pe rakh deta hai. Operator kaanpte hue bas itna bolta hai: *"The dam… he's at the dam."* Organist **radio pe fire** nahi karta. Woh mic operator ke haath me thama deta hai, taake operator khud boss ko batane pe majboor ho ki woh aa raha hai. Doosri taraf se sirf lambi khamoshi aati hai. Aakhir me Organist seedhi se utar kar ghode pe baithta hai aur **dam ki taraf** nikal jata hai.

Avoid me *"no aerial, no drone, camera never leaves the ground"* bhi daala hai.

[Write C:\Users\Zahid\AIShortFilms\films\iron-sunday\CHATGPT_MUSIC_BRIEF.md]
I'm making a short film and I need you to write Suno music prompts for it. You already know how I want the prompts written, so follow those instructions. Here is everything about the film, the scenes made so far, and my taste in music.

THE FILM
Title: IRON SUNDAY. A 6-8 minute AI-generated sci-fi spaghetti western with creature characters, 16:9, made for YouTube. Fast, kinetic, very little dialogue, lots of action. I edit it myself and lay the music under the scenes.
Logline: "He never runs. He just never stops."

WORLD
An off-world desert frontier called The Parch: rust-red mesas, cracked dust, blinding white salt flats, bleached sky with two pale moons in daylight. No law. Towns are scrap settlements of rusty tin, pipes and warped planks. Everything is dusty, rusty and old. The characters are grotesque creatures (reptiles, insects, scorpions, hyenas, crocodiles) riding gaunt reptile horses and rusty hover-trucks. Gritty, stylish and a little comic. The violence is action-movie style, not gory.

HERO
THE ORGANIST. A very tall, thin, silent gunman. His face is hidden behind a riveted rusty steel mask, with a dark brown hat, a faded red scarf, a long sand-coloured duster and two sawn-off double-barrel shotguns. He never speaks and never runs. He walks while everyone else runs. He rides a black reptile horse. The gang thought they had buried him three years ago, and now he is back. Nobody knows who he really is.

VILLAINS
- CALDERA: a big gila-monster gang boss with gold teeth and a silver cross. He is cocky, laughs a lot, and dies at the end of the first scene.
- His gang: creature gunmen on reptile horses, plus two hover-trucks.
- THE VOICE: the real villain, never seen yet. He is a deep, gravelly boss heard only over radios. At first he is cold and amused. Later he gets angry and short-tempered as his men keep dying. He is the one who "put the Organist in the ground" once. The story is a chain: every man the Organist kills leads to the next one above him, climbing toward THE VOICE.

OVERALL THEME AND FEEL
A lone, unstoppable avenger working his way up a chain of command across the desert. The mood is cool, dangerous and heroic, with swagger and a bit of dark humour. It is not sad, not slow and not horror. Think of the energy of a classic spaghetti western mixed with a modern fast action edit.

SCENES MADE SO FAR (in film order, approximate lengths)
1. OPENING RIDE (about 75 s, credits run over it). Nine creature gunmen on reptile horses and two hover-trucks race flat out across the open desert in bright midday sun. We see individual riders, serious and focused, then the convoy reaches a lonely ruined church, the Iron Mission, and the gang walks to its doors. Big, epic and energetic. This introduces the film.
2. THE CHURCH (about 30 s). Inside the dark ruined church, the masked Organist sits playing a wheezing old pipe organ. The gang bursts in. Caldera puts his hand on the organ and the music stops: "You are in my church, friend." The Organist pulls two shotguns out of the organ and the first gunman goes flying. The tension snaps into action.
3. CHURCH GUNFIGHT AND YARD (about 30 s). Fast shotgun fight. The gunmen go down one after another. Caldera runs out the back door into the yard and is shot down beside his horse. The Organist stands alone with smoking barrels, and the film's title appears.
4. THE RADIO (about 30 s). A truck radio crackles. THE VOICE calls for Caldera, then realises who is listening: "I put you in the ground once, gunman. Keep riding... and I'll put you back." The Organist shoots the radio and gallops away. Mysterious and menacing, then a push forward.
5. TRAVEL MONTAGE (about 30 s). The Organist gallops at full speed through dust storms and scrap towns past strange creature townsfolk: a mantis trader, a beetle miner, an old tortoise woman, a little scorpion. He slows and stops at the edge of a huge white salt flat. Adventurous, fast and fun.
6. SALT FLATS AMBUSH (about 60 s). Out on the blinding salt, a hover-truck with a roof machine gun and a scorpion rider charge at him head-on. He charges straight back and shoots the rider off his horse, then the machine gunner off the roof. He dodges the truck at the last moment and blasts its thruster, and the truck flips and rolls. Big, loud, wild action.
7. AFTERMATH (about 30 s). Quiet on the salt, with smoke rising from the wreck and bodies lying still. The truck radio barks: THE VOICE is now angry, "Boys? Pick up!... Answer me, you dogs!", and he warns a radio tower that the Organist is coming. The Organist spots a far radio mast, mounts, and gallops toward it.
8. DISTANT TOWER (5 s). Only the top of a radio mast with a blinking red light, far away in the blowing dust.

COMING NEXT (not made yet, so write cues for these only if I ask)
- A radio-tower scrap town: a quick shoot-out with two guards, and a frightened radio operator who gives up where the boss is.
- The climax at a dam, facing THE VOICE and his last men, then a short ending.

MY MUSIC TASTE
- I love spaghetti western music with a fun, swaggering desert feel, like the Rango soundtrack and the classic Morricone westerns.
- I want it catchy, energetic and galloping, with a strong memorable hook I can hum. It should be bold and adventurous with a cool "badass lone gunslinger" attitude.
- I do not like slow, moody, sleepy or sad music, horror-style drones, or generic trailer music. Even the quiet or tense scenes should keep a groove and a pulse.
- Earlier tries at the gunfight and aftermath music did not work for me, so give those scenes fresh ideas.

WHAT I NEED
Write Suno prompts for the scenes above, following the instructions I already gave you, and label each one with its scene number and name. Suggest which scenes can share one track and which need their own, so the film has a main theme that comes back.

What does IRON SUNDAY mean

=== ASSISTANT 2026-09-23T20:14 ===
IRON SUNDAY ka matlab film ki pehli scene se aata hai.

- **IRON:** Hero ke chehre pe zang-khaya lohe ka mask hai. Jis church mein kahani shuru hoti hai uska naam bhi Iron Mission hai. Lohe ki shotguns bhi isi naam ka hissa hain.
- **SUNDAY:** Sunday church ka din hai. Caldera ki gang church mein ghusti hai to wahan organ baj raha hota hai. Unhein lagta hai koi aam Sunday hai, lekin organ bajane wala wahi aadmi hai jise unhon ne teen saal pehle dafna diya tha.

Series bible mein hook yeh likha hai: is Sunday Iron Mission mein organ bajane wale ne lohe ka mask pehna hai, aur woh bolta nahi. Is liye naam ka seedha matlab hai "lohe wala Sunday", yaani woh Sunday jab masked aadmi hisaab lene wapas aaya.

Isi liye film ka poster aur title card dono hi church, organ aur mask ki taraf ishara karte hain.

=== ASSISTANT 2026-09-23T20:16 ===
Haan, THE ORGANIST suit karta hai, lekin ek kamzori hai jo series ke liye theek karni hogi.

**Kyun suit karta hai:**
- Pehli scene mein woh organ bajate hue hi introduce hota hai, aur shotguns bhi organ ke andar se nikalta hai. Is liye naam aur pehli yaad ek hi cheez hai.
- Naam ajeeb aur mysterious hai. Western mein koi hero organ bajane wala nahi hota, is liye log rukte hain aur sochte hain ke yeh kaun hai.
- Woh kabhi bolta nahi aur uska asli naam kisi ko nahi pata. Is liye uski pehchaan uske kaam se hoti hai, jaise western mein "The Stranger" ya "The Man with No Name".

**Kamzori:**
- Organ sirf pehle episode mein hai. Episode 2 ke baad woh radio towers, dams aur registan mein hai, aur wahan organ nahi hai. Agar organ wapas nahi aaya to naam dheere dheere be-matlab lagega.

**Iska hal:**
- Organ ki awaaz ko uski pehchaan bana dein. Jaise har episode mein woh ek baar kisi purani machine, radio ya pipe pe wahi chhoti dhun baja de, ya har episode ke end pe organ ki wahi do notes sunai dein.
- Music mein bhi uska theme organ se shuru ho. ChatGPT brief mein yeh baat add ki ja sakti hai.

Is hal ke saath THE ORGANIST series ke liye mazboot naam hai. Aap final karein to main series bible aur files mein naam update kar dunga.

=== USER 2026-09-23T20:43 ===
Even tho we tag images, i see that my character is ride normal horse in almost every video? why is this happening?

=== ASSISTANT 2026-09-23T20:44 ===
This happens because the prompt text and the reference image pull in different directions, and in these prompts the text wins. I can't see your renders, so this is based on how the prompts are written and how video models usually behave, not on checking the clips.

**Why it happens:**
- **The word "horse" is in every prompt.** We call the mount a "black dust-horse" and write "horse's head", "reins", "saddle" and "gallop". The model has seen millions of real horses with western riders, so the word "horse" pulls it straight to a normal horse.
- **The strange features are no longer written in the prompts.** The early prompts described the leathery hide, the missing mane, the bone ridges down the neck and the split-claw hooves. The newer prompts only say "black dust-horse" and trust the image to do the rest. One image against a strong word usually loses.
- **The image competes with many other tags.** A clip tags five or six images, and the model focuses on the characters and their faces. The mount is a small part of most frames, so its reference gets the least attention.
- **The sheet itself is close to a horse.** Image 2 shows a horse shape with a few changes, and it shows two colours, black and sand/grey. A design that close to a horse is easy for the model to "correct" back to a real one.

**How to fix it, strongest first:**
1. **Remove the word "horse" completely.** Call it "his black reptile mount" or give it its own name, and never write horse, horseback or horse's head. "Gallop", "saddle" and "reins" can stay.
2. **Describe the mount in every prompt**, not only by tag. A short fixed line would do it, for example: "a hairless black reptile beast with leathery skin, no mane, a bony ridge down its neck, a long lizard-like head and split-claw feet."
3. **Ban the normal horse in Avoid**: "no ordinary horse, no mane, no hair, no round hooves."
4. **Make a new sheet for the black mount only**, one colour and more clearly not a horse. For example a lizard head, a neck frill or a scaly tail. The further it is from a horse, the less the model slides back.

**One decision is yours.** If most of the clips you've already made show a normal horse, a new design will change how the mount looks from the next clip on. The other option is to accept a dark, rough-looking real horse and stop fighting it. That keeps the film consistent with what you already have, but you lose the sci-fi touch on the mount.

If you want to keep the creature mount, tell me. I'll write the new image 2 sheet and update TR-02, RT-01 and RT-02 with the new name, the fixed description line and the Avoid line. I'll also add it to the skill as a permanent rule.

- **Faasla kaise dikhta hai:** Mast har shot mein bada hota jata hai, 8 km se 3 km, phir 1 km, phir 300 m. Audience isi se samajhti hai ke woh qareeb aa raha hai.

- **Mast ka size:** Model har shot mein mast ka size theek se chhota-bada na kare, aur kisi shot mein mast bahut qareeb dikh jaye. Yeh sabse bada risk hai.

Charon competitor thumbnails dekh liye. Yeh images hain, video nahi, is liye Video Reference Lab ki zaroorat nahi. Sirf tasveer dekh ke design ka analysis kiya hai.

**Competitors mein kya common hai:**
- **Title upar left mein:** Teen thumbnails mein bada title left ke upar wale hisse mein hai, western font mein. Wanted Reloaded wale mein letters mein goliyon ke chhed bhi hain.

- **Ek chamakta rang:** Bounty Protocol mein neeli glowing bottles hain, baaqi sab dhool aur zang ke rang mein. Is se aankh seedhi us rang pe jati hai.

- **Western background:** Gali, registan ya lakdi ki imaaratein hain, thodi blur taake character alag dikhe.

- **Background mein toota church aur bada pipe organ.** Yeh hamari film ki pehchaan hai aur kisi competitor ke paas nahi.

## 1. Stand-off
**Kahani ka pehlu:** Ek aadmi poori gang ke khilaf. Organist STRIDER pe right mein bada hai, kandhe ke peeche se dikhta hai. Church ke saamne yard ke paar Caldera sone ke daanton se muskura raha hai, aur us ke saath teen riders hain. Shaam ki neechi dhoop aur lambe saaye hain.

**Font:** 1960s western poster.

**Nano Banana mein add karein:** Organist sheet, STRIDER sheet, Iron Mission church ki image, Caldera sheet, RIDERS group sheet.

```
YouTube thumbnail, 16:9, 1280x720, photoreal cinematic CG creature-feature western, high contrast, sharp focus.
Scene: a stand-off in the dusty yard in front of the ruined church from the attached church image, hard low sun, long shadows, dust in the air.
Right side, large and close to the camera: THE ORGANIST from the attached masked-gunman sheet, exactly as drawn: riveted rusty steel mask with one narrow dark glass eye slit, wide flat-brimmed dark brown hat, faded red scarf, sand-coloured duster, black gauntlet gloves, a sawn-off double-barrel shotgun in each hand, sitting on his black mount from the attached mount sheet, exactly as drawn: gaunt, long-legged, hairless black leathery hide, no mane, pale bone ridges down the neck, narrow bony head, split-claw feet. He is seen from behind his right shoulder at three-quarter angle, the mask turned so the eye slit catches a thin amber glint, both shotguns lowered at his sides. The red scarf blows in the wind; it is the only strong red in the image.
Left and middle, across the yard in front of the church doors, smaller and facing him: the boss lizard from the attached boss sheet, grinning with gold teeth, a hand on each revolver, and three gunmen from the attached riders sheet spread out beside him, each exactly as drawn, hands near their guns.
Title in the top-left corner over the sky: "THE ORGANIST" in tall narrow 1960s western movie-poster letters with slab serifs, cream with a thick gold outline and a deep brown drop shadow; under it, smaller, "EPISODE 1: IRON SUNDAY" in gold. No other text.
Colour: desaturated dust, rust and bone, warm low sunlight, deep shadows; the only strong colour is the red scarf.
Avoid: no ordinary horses, no mane, no face under the mask, no humans, no creatures or figures that are not on the attached sheets, no blood, no gore, no logos, no watermark, no misspelled words, no text except the two title lines.
```

STRIDER ke agle claw khuli khali qabar ke kinare pe hain, paas mein toota coffin aur bina naam ka cross hai. Peeche church dhundla sa hai. Organist ke ilawa koi aur figure nahi.

Peeche left mein ulta pada truck jal raha hai. Door right mein laal battee wala radio mast hai, jahan woh ja raha hai.

## Dam climax: plan (3 clips, 90 s)
**Kahani:** HUSK ne bataya tha ke boss dam pe hai. Wahan THE VOICE ka daaya haath baitha hai. THE VOICE khud abhi bhi nazar nahi aayega, kyun ke woh series ka aakhri villain hai.

**Naye characters (3 sheets, sab paani wale creatures, dam se match karte hain):**
- **HOOK:** Bada alligator snapping turtle boss. Kaanton wala bhaari khol, mudi hui chonch jaisa munh, aur ek bada lever-action shotgun.
- **WHISKER:** Lamba catfish gunman, munh pe lambi moochein aur rifle.
- **PINCH:** Crawdad gunman, ek bada claw aur ek pistol.

Organist ke saath yeh 4 characters bante hain, jo limit ke andar hai.

| Clip | Kya hoga | End |
|---|---|---|
| **DM-01 (30 s)** | Canyon ke beech ek bada sookha zang-khaya dam hai. Organist gallop karta hua dam ke upar wale raaste pe aata hai. WHISKER aur PINCH rifle ke saath raaste pe khade hain aur HOOK upar control house pe hai. Dam ke radio pe THE VOICE: "Hook. He's coming." HOOK: "Let him." | Locked wide jismein sab ki jagah dikhe, screenshot ke liye |
| **DM-02 (30 s)** | Foran fight. WHISKER aur PINCH saath khade hain, to ek double fire mein dono girte hain. HOOK lever kheench ke dam ka gate khol deta hai, aur neela paani garajta hua bahar nikalta hai. Poori film mein pehli baar neela rang dikhta hai. | Organist aur HOOK paani ki phuhaar mein aamne-saamne |
| **DM-03 (30 s)** | Aakhri duel. HOOK fire karta hai aur chook jata hai. Organist ka double fire usay railing ke upar se neeche paani mein gira deta hai. Dam ka radio kharkharata hai aur THE VOICE thandi awaaz mein kehta hai: "You're getting closer, gunman. Good." Organist is baar radio nahi phodta, handset ko latakta chhod deta hai aur STRIDER pe nikal jata hai. | Organist dam ke upar se door jata hua, "To be continued" |

**Is ending ke fayde:**
- **Episode 2 ke liye sawal:** THE VOICE ab gussa nahi, balki khush lagta hai, jaise yeh sab uska plan ho. Audience ke paas agle episode ke liye sawal bachta hai.
- **Neela paani climax ko alag banata hai:** Series bible mein neela rang sirf paani ke liye rakha tha, aur woh yahan pehli baar aata hai.

Pasand aaye to pehle HOOK, WHISKER aur PINCH ki sheets dunga, phir DM-01 ka prompt. Kuch badalna ho, jaise boss ka creature, dialogue ya ending, to bata dein.

=== USER 2026-09-24T03:26 ===
in The Ribcage ya at the ?

=== ASSISTANT 2026-09-24T03:26 ===
Rakhein "in The Ribcage". Yahi sahi aur behtar hai.

- **"in"** kisi town ya ilaqe ke andar ke liye bola jata hai, jaise "in Tombstone". The Ribcage ek town hai jo pasliyon ke andar bana hai, to "in" bilkul fit hai. Is mein ek ghutan wala ehsaas bhi hai, jaise villain usay kisi ke pet ke andar bula raha ho.
- **"at"** kisi ek nuqte ya imaarat ke liye hota hai, jaise "at the station" ya "at the dam". Is town ke liye "at" kamzor lagega.

DM-06 mein "in The Ribcage" hi likha hai, is liye kuch badalna nahi.

## RD-01B: Shooting the radio (5 s)
**Where it goes in the edit:** Use the RD-01 render up to shot 4, then this clip, then RD-02.

**Exactly what happens in this clip:**
- **The angle:** The camera is inside the HOVER-TRUCK cab, behind the steering wheel, looking out the side window at the Organist, just like your screenshot. The camera doesn't move and there are no cuts.

=== ASSISTANT 2026-09-25T01:44 ===
Us awaaz ko aam taur pe **impact** ya **hit** kehte hain. Title design mein is ke kuch aur naam bhi hain:

- **Title hit / title slam:** jab title ya banner zor se screen pe aata hai
- **Cinematic impact:** bhaari dhamaake jaisi thud, trailers mein bahut use hoti hai
- **Metal impact / metal slam:** hamare banner ke liye yahi sab se fit hai, kyun ke woh lohe pe lagta hai
- **Braam:** bahut gehri, bhaari horn jaisi awaaz. Movie trailers mein mashhoor hai, lekin hamare western ke liye thodi zyada modern hai.
- **Boom:** neeche ki gehri goonj jo hit ke baad aati hai

**Sound effect dhoondne ke liye yeh lafz search karein:** "metal impact", "cinematic metal hit", "heavy metal slam", "anvil hit", "rusty metal clang impact".

**Mera mashwara:** Banner ke liye "heavy metal slam" ya "anvil hit" rakhein, aur us ke neeche halka sa "boom" mila dein. Is se lohe ki thok bhi sunai degi aur bhaari goonj bhi, jo dono film ki zang-khayi duniya se match karti hain.

=== USER 2026-09-25T09:30 ===
yr woh konsy subtitles hoty jo choty se hoty yellow type bracket mein hoty jo translation k lye use hoty ya jese THE Voice k lye capcut mein tempelate milega ya khud bnany paregy

=== ASSISTANT 2026-09-25T09:30 ===
Is ke do naam hain, aur dono thode alag cheezein hain:

- **Yellow subtitles:** Purani filmon aur DVDs mein chhote peele subtitles hote the, khaas kar doosri zubaan ke translation ke liye. Peela rang is liye ke safed aur roshan scenes mein bhi padhne mein aaye.
- **SDH ya closed captions:** Bracket wale subtitles is qism ke hote hain, jaise `[radio crackles]` ya `[gunshot]`. SDH ka matlab "subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing" hai, yaani woh log jo sun nahi sakte. In mein awaazon ka zikr bracket mein hota hai.

Film ki ek aur riwayat hai: jo awaaz screen pe nazar aane wale insaan ki na ho, jaise radio, phone ya door se aati awaaz, us ke subtitles **italic** yaani tircha likhe jate hain. THE VOICE ke liye yeh bilkul fit hai.

**CapCut mein template dhoondne ki zaroorat nahi.** Ek dafa khud bana ke save kar lein:
1. **Captions:** Text mein "Auto captions" chala dein, taake THE VOICE ki lines khud likh jayein. Ya Text mein jaa ke khud type kar lein.
2. **Style set karein:**
   - Font saada rakhein, jaise Arial ya Helvetica jaisa koi.
   - Rang peela.
   - Patli kaali outline ya halki shadow.
   - Chhota size, screen ke bilkul neeche.
   - THE VOICE ki lines italic.
3. **Save karein:** Style ko preset ke taur pe save kar lein. Zyadatar CapCut versions mein text style ke paas "Save preset" jaisa option hota hai. Phir baaqi lines pe ek click mein lag jayega.

**Hamari film ke liye mera mashwara:**
- **THE VOICE ki lines:** Peele, italic, bina bracket ke. Jaise: *So the rumors were true. You really came back from the dead.*
- **Awaazon ke liye bracket, sirf zaroorat pe:** Jaise shuru mein `[radio crackles]`. Har awaaz pe na lagayein, warna screen bhar jayegi.
- **Baaqi characters ki lines:** Wahi peela style, lekin seedha, italic nahi. Jaise DRIBBLE ki "Please... please, don't kill me!"

[Write C:\Users\Zahid\AIShortFilms\films\iron-sunday\COLOR_GRADE_CAPCUT.txt]
EP01 colour grade in CapCut desktop (owner 2026-09-25). Goal: one look from the first shot to the last.
Look: dusty spaghetti western, warm sun-bleached highlights, slightly cool shadows, low saturation,
the red scarf is the only strong red. Numbers are starting points; judge by eye on 3-4 different clips.

STEP 1 - FIX EACH CLIP FIRST (select the clip > Adjust > Basic)
Only fix clips that stand out (too bright, too dark, too blue, too orange). Use a well-matched clip as the
"hero" reference (e.g. a CH-02 church-yard wide) and nudge the others toward it:
- Exposure / Highlights / Shadows until brightness matches the hero.
- Temperature / Tint until the sand looks the same colour as in the hero.
Do NOT add the look here, only make clips match each other.

STEP 2 - ONE LOOK FOR THE WHOLE FILM (Adjustment layer)
Adjustment > Custom adjustment > drag onto a track ABOVE all clips > stretch it over the whole timeline.
Basic:
  Temperature +10    Tint +3        Saturation -15
  Contrast +12       Highlights -15 Shadows -8
  Whites -5          Blacks -10     Brilliance +5
  Sharpen 10         Vignette 15    Grain 15
Color wheels (if available): Shadows toward teal (small), Highlights toward orange (small),
  Midtones leave alone.
HSL:
  Red     saturation +10 (keeps the scarf strong)
  Orange  saturation 0, luminance +5 (sand and skin)
  Yellow  saturation -15
  Green   saturation -40 (nothing should look lush)
  Cyan/Blue saturation -25, hue slightly toward cyan (sky stays pale and dusty)
  Purple/Magenta saturation -30
Curves (optional): a gentle S-curve on RGB, and lift the very bottom point a little for a faded film black.
When happy: Save as preset ("ORGANIST LOOK") so Episode 2 uses the same grade.

STEP 3 - SCENES THAT NEED THEIR OWN LAYER
If a scene still looks different under the main layer (church interior, dam, radio-tower dust), add a
second short adjustment layer only over that scene and correct it (usually Exposure and Temperature)
until it sits next to the scenes around it. Keep the main layer on top of everything.

STEP 4 - CHECK
Scrub the whole film at low speed and watch the cuts between scenes: the sand colour, the sky colour and
the darkness of the shadows should not jump. The red scarf should always be the strongest colour.
Title card and black frames: exclude them from grain/vignette if they look muddy (cut the layer there).


=== ASSISTANT 2026-09-25T11:03 ===
To keep one look through the whole film, do it in two passes in CapCut: first make the clips match each other, then put one grade on top of everything. This is a starting recipe for a dusty spaghetti-western look, not a tested preset. Try it on 3–4 clips and adjust by eye.

**Step 1: Match the clips to each other**
- Pick one clip that already looks right as your reference, for example a CH-02 church-yard wide.
- Only fix clips that stand out. Select the clip, open **Adjust → Basic** and change only these:
  - **Exposure / Highlights / Shadows** until the brightness matches the reference.
  - **Temperature / Tint** until the sand is the same colour as in the reference.
- Don't add the look yet. This pass only makes the clips match.

**Step 2: One look for the whole film (adjustment layer)**
Go to **Adjustment → Custom adjustment**, drag it onto a track above all your clips, and stretch it over the full timeline.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Temperature | +10 |
| Tint | +3 |
| Saturation | -15 |
| Contrast | +12 |
| Highlights | -15 |
| Shadows | -8 |
| Whites | -5 |
| Blacks | -10 |
| Brilliance | +5 |
| Sharpen | 10 |
| Vignette | 15 |
| Grain | 15 |

In **HSL**, on the same layer:
- **Red:** saturation +10, so the red scarf stays the strongest colour.
- **Yellow:** -15
- **Green:** -40, so nothing looks lush.
- **Blue/Cyan:** -25, with the hue shifted slightly toward cyan so the sky stays pale and dusty.
- **Purple/Magenta:** -30

If your CapCut has **Color wheels**, push the shadows slightly toward teal and the highlights slightly toward orange.

When you're happy with it, **Save as preset** ("ORGANIST LOOK") so Episode 2 gets the same grade.

**Step 3: Scenes that still look different**
If a scene still doesn't match under the main layer (the church interior, the dam, the dusty radio tower), add a second short adjustment layer over just that scene. Fix only **Exposure** and **Temperature** there.

**Step 4: Check the cuts**
Play through the scene changes slowly. The sand colour, the sky and the darkness of the shadows shouldn't jump between shots. If grain or vignette makes the title card or the black frames look muddy, cut the layer at those spots.
